title: impl_string_enum_serde: Display impls duplicate wire string literals
description: In crate-jmap-mail-types/src/submission.rs, for Delivered (lines 106-123), Displayed (lines 139-152), and UndoStatus (lines 170-185), the wire-format string literals appear twice: once in the impl_string_enum_serde\! macro invocation and once in the manual fmt::Display impl. For example, 'queued', 'yes', 'no', 'unknown' for Delivered. If a wire string ever needed to change, a developer would need to update both places and could easily miss the Display impl. A cleaner pattern would be to add Display support to the macro itself (a second arm), or have Display delegate to the Serialize path (e.g., serialize to a temporary string). The duplication is currently consistent (no bugs observed), but is a maintenance hazard. Priority P3.
